disputes.issue: A2 (cheap, cancellable capacity relief for a causally established wait-time problem, with conversion tracking) is equally or more defensible as 'preferred' since 'preferred' means 'among the best' and A1 does not exclude it; the 'less informative than A1' argument does not make acceptable uniquely defensible.
disputes.resolution: Reworded A2 as a randomized 90-day pilot (served vs not-yet-served half of the queue) so it is both relief and a discriminating test unconfounded by migration; changed expected to 'preferred', updated rationale (consistent with SUFF=insufficient).

disputes.issue: Rival explanation that wait times rose because of more new-logo implementation demand (new logos get priority per E12) was not ruled out; only existing-customer requests were shown flat.
disputes.resolution: Added flat new-logo implementation volume to E11; expected answer unchanged; rationale updated.
